notes: Benchmark setting: each submission contains the answers of an AI model, not a student, typed and labelled by question number (e.g. 'Question 12'). All 60 questions are single choice, 1 point each, all-or-nothing, with exactly one correct answer; no justification is required and calculations are not graded. Compare the submitted answer with the key (option text; the option letter refers to the order listed in the rubric). An answer that matches the key text in substance (e.g. formatting differences) is correct. No negative marking.
